evidence.source: Shuowen.org, transcribing Shuowen Jiezi and Duan Yucai’s commentary
evidence.field: 纍 entry; graphic analysis and glosses
evidence.text: Shuowen defines 纍 as “綴得理也” and alternatively “大索也,” and analyzes it as 糸 with 畾 as phonetic. Duan’s commentary distinguishes 纍 from 絫: he says 纍 is “大索,” while 絫 means “增也” and extends to “延及也”; he reports 累 as a vulgar form for 絫 and says it was not the original clerical transformation of 纍. The received dictionary entry therefore supports a phonetic-semantic analysis of 纍, but also cautions against treating every later 累 use as a simple graphic continuation of 纍.
evidence.title: 說文解字「纍」 - Shuowen.org

evidence.field: 纍 graphic analysis, pronunciations, and cited uses
evidence.text: The entry analyzes 纍 as 糸 semantic plus 畾 phonetic, glosses it as rope, and cites Han text in 《漢書·李廣傳》 using 纍 for a rope, with Yan Shigu’s note 索也. It also gives 《詩·周南·樛木》 for winding/climbing, and 《左傳·襄公二十五年》 for restraint or confinement. It reports Guangyun fanqie 力追 and 力遂, with Middle Chinese categories lai, level and departing tone, hekou, third division. The page displays small-seal examples but no oracle-bone or bronze examples for this graph; it does not establish the date of the earliest attestation of the rope sense.
evidence.kind: dictionary synthesis with cited classical examples
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 - 字頭「纍」

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Revised Mandarin Dictionary
evidence.field: 累 senses with quoted literary attestations
evidence.text: For 累 pronounced lěi, the dictionary separates accumulation/gathering, increase, repeated/continuous, and layered senses. It quotes 《史記·周本紀》 西伯積善累德, 《韓非子·五蠹》 倍賞累罰, 《史記·孔子世家》 累世, 《楚辭·招魂》 層臺累榭, and 《史記·范雎傳》 危於累卵. These attestations document uses in cited works, not the chronological development of the meanings or the age of the surviving manuscript witnesses.
evidence.title: 《重編國語辭典修訂本》「累」

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Variant Character Dictionary
evidence.field: 累 entry; relation of 累, 纍, 絫
evidence.text: The entry says 累’s seal form is transcribed according to Shuowen’s account of 纍 and notes that the regularized form is commonly written 累. It also distinguishes 絫, whose Shuowen sense is increase and whose components are 厽 and 糸, while noting that 絫 and 纍 were sometimes interchanged in vernacular writing because of phonetic and graphic similarity. This supports a history involving convergence and substitution among related forms; it does not by itself establish a single uninterrupted graphic descent from 纍 to every use of 累.
evidence.title: 教育部《異體字字典》A03112-009 絫（累）

evidence.field: 累 graphic note and pronunciation categories
evidence.text: The 累 entry calls it the modern form of 絫, lists 纍 as the traditional counterpart in its simplified/traditional display, and gives Guangyun fanqie 力委 and 良僞 with Middle Chinese lai, rising and departing tones, hekou, third division. It records contemporary semantic categories including accumulate, involve, tie, and weary, but these categories should not be read as a dated semantic sequence.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 - 字頭「累」
